content.comment_body: Is it possible to control [product_name] drive using [product_name] controller, specifically for forward and reverse operation? I am unsure if it's possible. If anyone has experience, please reply.

Hello. Yes, what you are asking is possible. Please refer to the manual provided with the drive, or download it from [url]. The hardware section (see page 6) explains the input connections using the drive's 24V power source, showing both NPN and PNP methods. You can control the drive using the relay output in either configuration. Alternatively, an external power supply can be connected – instead of using the usual pins, apply a power level to the DIC terminal (24V for NPN, 0V for PNP). For setup and commissioning, check page 12 for quick commissioning and page 13 for connection macros, which can be used as a basis. Recently, using the CN02 macro worked for me, as described in the settings information (page 15). After the quick commissioning, you can further customize parameters. In my case, I set I1 for RUN (FORWARD) and I2 for RUN (REVERSE); CN02 associates DIRECTION to I2. Refer to page 18 under parameter P701 for available values. I modified P702 index 0, changing its value from 12 to 2. Be attentive to index numbers—if you enter a setting, "in 0" is shown; pressing OK accesses the actual configuration. Index numbers allow parameter adjustment for multiple motors, with index 0 for the primary motor. Hope this is helpful. If you have further questions, you may consult the dedicated drive group for additional support. Good luck. [user_name]
Hello [user_name], thank you very much for your prompt assistance.
